messages:
alice_support: Hey team — customer efg reported streaming responses cutting off mid-event when their token rotates. They see a 401 in logs and the client reconnects but gets only a partial last chunk. They’re behind Cloudflare -> ALB -> envoy origin.

efg_customer: repro steps — start a chat stream, wait ~55s, token rotates on the client, client sends new Authorization in reconnect, server logs "upstream closed connection" and client shows truncated last event. Happens ~40% of attempts.

dave_support: thanks — can you paste the exact curl you used to repro? and any server error lines?

efg_customer: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream"
then after token rotates client reconnects with "Authorization: Bearer NEW_TOKEN". Server logs: "[2026-02-21T14:03:55Z] error: upstream response closed (EOF) mid-chunk". Cloudflare shows 502 to client in some traces.

carol_eng_sre: quick hypothesis: token rotation causes a midstream re-auth flow which triggers a new connection from the client. Cloudflare/ALB HTTP/2 windowing or proxy buffering may swallow trailing chunk frames during the handoff, producing truncated final SSE event. Also repeated reconnects could explain the billing spike reported.

bob_devex: short checklist to triage:
- confirm if Cloudflare is doing HTTP/2 -> origin h2 or h1 (we've seen h2 windowing breakage)
- try disabling Cloudflare proxy for the customer (DNS bypass) to isolate ALB/Envoy behavior
- capture tcpdump on origin during repro and a small server-side trace

alice_support: customer replied: Cloudflare is in Full (proxy) mode; origin receives h2 from CF. They can toggle but want us to test first.

carol_eng_sre: Suggest trying two quick repros:
1) Force client to use HTTP/1.1 for the TLS connection (curl: --http1.1 -N) — if problem disappears, CF->origin h2 windowing likely.
2) Increase ALB idle timeout to >120s and set origin keepalive headers to ensure half-close not happening.

bob_devex: Also ask them to run this minimal curl sequence and attach the raw output:

# start stream with old token
curl --http1.1 -N -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream" \
  | ts # (or just save to file)

# simulate token rotate, reconnect:
curl --http1.1 -N -H "Authorization: Bearer NEW_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream" > /tmp/reconnect.out

If the second stream returns full events with http1.1, that’s telling.

efg_customer: ran http1.1 test — looks MUCH better, second reconnect contained the full last event.

carol_eng_sre: ok that narrows it. Next step: request a pcap during an h2 repro (CF proxied). Run on origin (one-liner):
sudo tcpdump -i any -s 0 -w /tmp/sse_h2_repro.pcap host <origin-ip> and port 443

and also enable envoy debug for http2 frame logs for a few minutes.

alice_support: customer worried about billing — they reported a 3x token usage spike during the reconnect flurry. Can we confirm repeated reconnects are being charged?

bob_devex: yes repeated connections produce repeated token usage and billing events. Short-term mitigation: enable client-side exponential backoff + de-dup token rotation to avoid immediate reconnect storms. Server-side mitigation: accept a brief 401 and allow token refresh window (grace period) to reduce reconnects; we can also add a header to signal client to retry without re-auth for N seconds.

carol_eng_sre: long-term: we should harden proxy path:
- ask CF to disable h2 to origin for affected zone or enable "origin keepalive with h2 window tweaks".
- tune ALB idle_timeout to > client rotation interval + small buffer.
- ensure envoy connection draining doesn't half-close chunked SSE while frames pending.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: rolled envoy 1.26.3 -> 1.27.0 to pick up http2 bugfix (ID RW-1342). Rollout completed to staging at 2026-02-22T03:20Z.

alice_support: we will ask the customer to bypass CF (temp), re-run h2 repro, and capture tcpdump + envoy http2 logs. Also suggested http1.1 test which already improved.

efg_customer: bypassed CF for a test and replayed the scenario — no truncation, no 502. Attached small logs in the ticket. Thanks.

dave_support: great. Action items:
- customer to provide tcpdump + envoy http2 logs (efg)
- SRE to review envoy http2 frame handling and ALB idle timeouts (carol)
- DevEx to draft client guidance on token rotation backoff + http1.1 fallback (bob)

carol_eng_sre: noted. I’ll triage the envoy h2 logs tomorrow morning and open a follow-up if we need a runtime flag to avoid draining SSE streams during token handoffs.

alice_support: thanks everyone, marking this thread as next-action-triaged. :thumbsup:
